as_told.title: UAP drawn to nuclear and WMD facilities

plain: UFOs are said to show up again and again around nuclear sites, from weapons bases to power plants, all over the world. Michels states it simply on one episode: "UFOs show up around nuclear sites all over the world." Eric Haseltine, a former NSA official, is more careful. He tells Michels the link is real enough to discuss but that "we're trying to be honest and say, 'Yo, maybe yes, maybe no,'" since "there's a lot more sensors around nuclear plants," and so more chances to notice anything. Matthew Brown, a Pentagon whistleblower, goes further. He says it is "established beyond a reasonable doubt" that not just nuclear sites but weapons of mass destruction in general "draw their attention." He leans on the book UFOs and Nukes by Robert Hastings. If true, it would mean whatever is behind these sightings takes a particular interest in humanity's most dangerous weapons.
